content: Why Volunteer at WikiDoc? What are the Rewards for Me? WikiDoc receives an impressive 5 million views per day, providing a vast audience for your contributions. Expand Your CV By volunteering, you have the opportunity to enhance your CV by taking on roles such as Associate or Assistant Editor-in-Chief for various disease topics, provided you make meaningful contributions to those areas. If you click the permanent link button at the bottom of a page, you can generate a hyperlink to the version of the page you last edited. This link can be included in your CV, allowing readers to view your specific contributions before any subsequent edits by others. Become a WikiDoc Scholar and Deputy Editor-in-Chief Working at WikiDoc in the Longwood Medical Area offers an academic environment with access to valuable resources and information, helping you build a career in research. You are encouraged to participate in various WikiDoc projects, such as the Board Review and Crowd Diagnosis initiatives. Individuals who make significant contributions are recognized with a WikiDoc Scholar Certificate. Prepare for Your Board Exams As a WikiDoc Scholar, you can contribute to the Board Review Project, which allows you to author standard board examination questions. This project helps solidify your understanding of medical knowledge and pathophysiological concepts, which can positively impact your test scores. WikiDoc encourages contributions to exams such as the MCAT, USMLE Steps (1, 2, and 3), and specialty board exams. Networking Opportunities By including your email address as an editor, you can connect with thousands of students, physicians, and patients worldwide who view your contributions. With 5 million views per day, your work reaches a global audience, showcasing the results of your efforts to millions of people. Receive a Letter of Recommendation The Editor-in-Chief of WikiDoc, Dr. C. Gibson, may, at his discretion, provide a letter of recommendation. This letter will reflect the quality and quantity of your academic achievements. CME Credits Soon, you will have the opportunity to claim Continuing Medical Education (CME) credits for your activities as an editor at WikiDoc. Who Can Volunteer at WikiDoc? WikiDoc welcomes individuals from all over the world to join the team. You do not need to be a physician to apply for this position.
